description: Start a brew of a CarlNotes topic now. Carl reads its sources and keeps what's worth reading, and the brew sends its report and records its podcast episode like any other. It takes one of the account's daily brews, and only the topic's owner or an admin may start it. Past the daily limit no brew starts and nothing bills. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes to run a topic, with phrases like brew this topic now or run this topic now.

topic_id.description: The topic's id. Optional on a topic-bound server, which already knows its topic.

name: start_scan
title: Brew a topic
